key_claims.claim: Specific ultrasound features can be identified in ovarian mature cystic teratomas that have undergone malignant transformation, based on a 26-case multicenter series
A self-supervised foundation model pretrained on 25 million DBT slices outperforms ImageNet baselines on breast density, cancer risk, and lesion detection tasks
LLM-generated summaries of EHR notes outperformed clinician-provided clinical histories on comprehensiveness and radiologist-rated usefulness in a 20-reader study
Photon-counting CT-derived extracellular volume fraction stages liver fibrosis with performance equivalent to MR elastography in a prospective 139-patient cohort
FDA-cleared radiology AI devices lead all specialties in Predetermined Change Control Plan adoption, but documentation transparency remains inconsistent
